description: Utility functions for reading, writing, and analyzing audio files, specifically handling format detection, conversion to int16 PCM, and stereo to mono conversion, used in integration tests.

methods.name: read_audio_file
methods.description: Reads an audio file, detects format, converts to int16 mono, and returns audio data with sample rate.

methods.name: write_audio_file
methods.description: Writes audio data to a file in supported formats (.wav, .flac, .ogg).

methods.name: calculate_audio_stats
methods.description: Calculates statistical metrics (min, max, mean, std, rms, samples) for audio data.
